summary: Equity LifeStyle Properties, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its 2026 Annual Meeting results and a dividend declaration. Stockholders voted on three routine proposals: election of nine directors (all elected), ratification of Ernst & Young as auditor, and advisory approval of executive compensation (all passed). Separately, the board declared a Q2 2026 dividend of $0.5425 per share (annualized $2.17), payable July 10, 2026 to holders of record June 26, 2026. The filing is a routine current report covering standard shareholder meeting outcomes and a regular dividend. No special-situation event is present.
